DyadicTreeMartingale.new:
let A : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    (dyadicLaw k).expect (fun α => energy p (descendant t k α))
  let B : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    (dyadicLaw k).expect (fun α => ‖splitCoefficient (descendant t k α)‖ ^ p)
  change A n + (∑ j : Fin n, B j.val) = energy p t
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [A, descendant, FiniteLaw.expect_const]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last]
      have hstep : A (n + 1) + B n = A n := expected_energy_step hp t n
      linarith
DyadicTreeMartingale.reason: Rewrite the finite telescope at the scalar-sequence level before expanding dependent word expectations. This avoids Lean 4.31 producing mismatched Fintype instances under Fin.castSucc rewriting; the energy identity and hypotheses are unchanged.

rw [μ.fiberSum_eq_vexpect_indicator, μ.fiberSum_eq_vexpect_indicator]
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, ite_smul, one_smul, zero_smul] using
    μ.vexpect_key_smul_conditionalAverage key F

FiniteConditionalAverage.new:
have indicator (H : Ω → E) :
      μ.fiberSum (parent ∘ key) H a =
        μ.vexpect (fun ω => (if parent (key ω) = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0) • H ω) := by
    rw [μ.fiberSum_eq_vexpect_indicator]
    apply congrArg μ.vexpect
    funext ω
    by_cases h : parent (key ω) = a <;> simp [Function.comp_apply, h]
  calc
    μ.fiberSum (parent ∘ key) (μ.conditionalAverage key F) a =
        μ.vexpect (fun ω =>
          (if parent (key ω) = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0) • μ.conditionalAverage key F ω) :=
      indicator _
    _ = μ.vexpect (fun ω => (if parent (key ω) = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0) • F ω) :=
      μ.vexpect_key_smul_conditionalAverage key F
        (fun b => if parent b = a then 1 else 0)
    _ = μ.fiberSum (parent ∘ key) F a := (indicator F).symm
FiniteConditionalAverage.reason: Prove the indicator-function equality pointwise and compose it with the existing conditional-average identity, avoiding a Lean 4.31 simpa elaboration mismatch. No theorem statement or decision-instance hypothesis changes.
